# Tax (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Tax` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 3 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-tax) | `GET /ref/tax?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&IsActive={IsActive}&IsTaxForSale={IsTaxForSale}&IsTaxForPurchase={IsTaxForPurchase}&Account={Account}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-tax) | `POST /ref/tax` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-tax) | `PUT /ref/tax` |


Tax CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Tax
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                 |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ID`                  | Guid      | 50        |           | Unique ID             |
| `Name`                | String    | 50        | Yes       | Tax name              |
| `Account`             | String    |           | Yes       | ChartOfAccount Code with Class == `LIABILITY` && Status == `ACTIVE` |
| `IsActive`            | Bool      |           | Yes       | Points that tax is Active |
| `TaxInclusive`        | Bool      |           | Yes       | Points that tax is Inclusive |
| `TaxPercent`          | Decimal   |           |           | Tax percentage, should be between 0 and 100. Read-only |
| `IsTaxForSale`        | Bool      |           |           | Points that tax is used for Sale |
| `IsTaxForPurchase`    | Bool      |           |           | Points that tax is used for Purchase |
| `Components` |<a href="#TaxComponentModel"><b>[] Tax Component Model</b></a>||||

## Tax

Path: `/ref/tax`

<a id="get-ref-tax"></a>
### GET /ref/tax?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&IsActive={IsActive}&IsTaxForSale={IsTaxForSale}&IsTaxForPurchase={IsTaxForPurchase}&Account={Account}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Fixed Asset Type with the specific ID
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return accounts that start with the specific name
- `IsActive` (optional, bool): Only return ACTIVE taxation rules
- `IsTaxForSale` (optional, bool): Only return taxation rules which are applicable for Sales
- `IsTaxForPurchase` (optional, bool): Only return taxation rules which are applicable for Purchase
- `Account` (optional, string): Only return taxation rules linked to specific accounte
